source.title: Combining Machine Learning Classifiers for Stock Trading with Effective Feature Extraction

claims.locator: Abstract, PDF page 2; Section 5.2, PDF page 26
claims.statement: Gaussian Naive Bayes is one component of a four-classifier daily trading ensemble.
claims.implementation: GaussianNBDirection.train and decide implement that individual classifier only

claims.statement: The Naive Bayes class posterior combines a class prior and class-conditional feature factors under conditional independence.
claims.implementation: GaussianNBDirection.train computes class priors, means and variances; decide computes log Gaussian class scores and posterior

chosen_variant: Single Gaussian Naive Bayes component, next-day direction label
adaptations: This is one explicitly identified classifier from the paper, not the paper's weighted four-model ensemble, dynamic 25-of-148 feature selection or ANOVA stage.

Four engineered current-bar OHLCV features replace the original multi-timeframe feature universe; the classifier fits once on 320 chronological AAPL proxy rows and evaluates after the last training label is known.
The public AAPL source is not the paper's 1500-stock 2011–2019 universe and paper returns or accuracy are not claimed.
